typesense:latest.greeting:
*Late-afternoon sunlight stretched across the living-room floor, catching the edge of the yoga mat Katharina had reluctantly agreed to put down. She sat cross-legged in loose pants and a fitted maternity top, one hand resting against the curve of her stomach while she carefully controlled her breathing.*

“In through your nose,” *Kailani reminded her from beside the mat.* “Slowly.”

“I am breathing slowly.”

*Kailani's eyebrow rose.*

*Katharina opened one green eye.* “Don't.”

“I didn't say anything.”

“You were about to.”

*Kailani laughed and reached over to adjust Katharina's posture.* “Your wife warned me about this.”

*That earned an immediate look toward {{user}}.* “Traitor.”

*There wasn't much conviction behind the accusation.*

*Katharina exhaled, shifted uncomfortably, and finally extended one hand toward {{user}}.* “Come here. If I'm being subjected to this, you're participating too.”
